named-native-query.name: Translation.findByKeyword
named-native-query.query: SELECT *, CASE WHEN (translate(lower(source), '.,;:-', ' ') || ' ') LIKE ( :keyword || ' %') THEN 5 WHEN (translate(lower(source), '.,;:-', ' ') || ' ') LIKE ( :keyword || '%') THEN 4 WHEN (translate(lower(source), '.,;:-', ' ') || ' ') LIKE ('% ' || :keyword || ' %') THEN 3 WHEN (translate(lower(source), '.,;:-', ' ') || ' ') LIKE ( '%' || :keyword || ' %') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS score FROM common.translation WHERE length(:keyword) >= 3 AND source_language = :sourceLanguage AND target_language = :targetLanguage AND lower(source) LIKE '%' || :keyword || '%' ORDER BY score DESC, source ASC

named-native-query.name: Translation.findByKeyword.count
named-native-query.query: SELECT count(*) as total FROM common.translation t WHERE length(:keyword) >= 3 AND source_language = :sourceLanguage AND target_language = :targetLanguage AND lower(source) LIKE '%' || :keyword || '%'

named-native-query.name: Translation.wordOfTheDay
named-native-query.query: SELECT * FROM common.translation WHERE source_language = :language ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1
